en.ui_workspace_hint: Your workspace's short name — for example demo
en.ui_locked_out: Too many attempts — try again in a few minutes.
en.ui_tg_replace_hint: Pasting a new token replaces the current connection. If you revoke the token in BotFather, paste the new one here straight away.
en.ui_tg_token_dead: The stored token no longer works — it was revoked in BotFather. Paste the current token to reconnect.
en.ui_tg_webhook_wrong: Telegram is pointing somewhere else — paste the token again to fix it.

am.ui_workspace_hint: የሥራ ቦታዎ አጭር ስም — ለምሳሌ demo
am.ui_wrong_credentials: የሥራ ቦታ፣ ኢሜይል ወይም የይለፍ ቃል ተሳስቷል።
am.ui_locked_out: ብዙ ሙከራዎች ነበሩ — ከጥቂት ደቂቃዎች በኋላ ይሞክሩ።
am.ui_tg_replace_hint: አዲስ ቶክን መለጠፍ አሁን ያለውን ግንኙነት ይተካል። በBotFather ቶክኑን ከሰረዙ አዲሱን ወዲያውኑ እዚህ ይለጥፉ።
am.ui_tg_token_dead: የተቀመጠው ቶክን ከአሁን በኋላ አይሰራም — በBotFather ተሰርዟል። ለመገናኘት አሁን ያለውን ቶክን ይለጥፉ።
am.ui_tg_webhook_wrong: Telegram ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እያመለከተ ነው — ለማስተካከል ቶክኑን እንደገና ይለጥፉ።

om.ui_workspace_hint: Maqaa gabaabaa iddoo hojii keessanii — fakkeenyaaf demo
om.ui_wrong_credentials: Iddoon hojii, imeeliin yookaan jechi darbii dogoggora.
om.ui_locked_out: Yaaliin baay'een tureera — daqiiqaa muraasa booda irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
om.ui_tg_replace_hint: Tookinii haaraa maxxansuun walqabsiisa ammaa bakka bu'a. BotFather keessatti tookinii yoo haqxan, isa haaraa battalumatti asitti maxxansaa.
om.ui_tg_token_dead: Tookiniin kuufame kana booda hin hojjetu — BotFather keessatti haqameera. Walqabsiisuuf tookinii ammaa maxxansaa.
om.ui_tg_webhook_wrong: Telegram bakka biraa agarsiisaa jira — sirreessuuf tookinii irra deebi'aa maxxansaa.

ti.ui_workspace_hint: ሓጺር ስም ናይ ስራሕ ቦታኹም — ንኣብነት demo
ti.ui_wrong_credentials: ናይ ስራሕ ቦታ፣ ኢመይል ወይ መሕለፊ ቃል ተጋግዩ እዩ።
ti.ui_locked_out: ብዙሕ ፈተነታት ነይሩ — ድሕሪ ቁሩብ ደቓይቕ ፈትኑ።
ti.ui_tg_replace_hint: ሓድሽ ቶክን ምልጣፍ ነቲ ዘሎ ርክብ ይትክኦ። ኣብ BotFather ቶክን እንተሰሪዝኩም፣ ነቲ ሓድሽ ብቕጽበት ኣብዚ ለጥፉዎ።
ti.ui_tg_token_dead: እቲ ዝተቐመጠ ቶክን ደጊም ኣይሰርሕን እዩ — ኣብ BotFather ተሰሪዙ እዩ። ንምርኻብ ነቲ ሕጂ ዘሎ ቶክን ለጥፉ።
ti.ui_tg_webhook_wrong: Telegram ናብ ካልእ ቦታ የመልክት ኣሎ — ንምእራም ነቲ ቶክን ደጊምኩም ለጥፉ።
ti.ui_tg_last_error: ናይ Telegram ናይ መወዳእታ ናይ ምልኣኽ ጌጋ: {error}

so.ui_workspace_hint: Magaca gaaban ee goobta shaqadaada — tusaale demo
so.ui_wrong_credentials: Goobta shaqada, iimaylka ama erayga sirta ah waa khalad.
so.ui_locked_out: Isku dayo badan ayaa dhacay — dhawr daqiiqo ka dib isku day.
so.ui_tg_replace_hint: Ku dhejinta tookin cusub waxay beddeshaa xiriirka hadda jira. Haddii aad tookinka ka burisid BotFather, kan cusub isla markiiba halkan ku dheji.
so.ui_tg_token_dead: Tookinka kaydsan hadda ma shaqeeyo — waxaa laga buriyay BotFather. Si aad dib ugu xirto, ku dheji tookinka hadda jira.
so.ui_tg_webhook_wrong: Telegram meel kale ayuu tilmaamayaa — si aad u saxdo, tookinka mar kale ku dheji.

sw.ui_login_subtitle: Konsoli ya wafanyakazi ya Olink Desk
sw.ui_workspace_hint: Jina fupi la eneo lako la kazi — kwa mfano demo
sw.ui_wrong_credentials: Eneo la kazi, barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi.
sw.ui_locked_out: Majaribio mengi mno — jaribu tena baada ya dakika chache.
sw.ui_tg_replace_hint: Kubandika tokeni mpya hubadilisha muunganisho wa sasa. Ukifuta tokeni katika BotFather, bandika mpya hapa mara moja.
sw.ui_tg_token_dead: Tokeni iliyohifadhiwa haifanyi kazi tena — ilifutwa katika BotFather. Bandika tokeni ya sasa ili kuunganisha upya.
sw.ui_tg_webhook_wrong: Telegram inaelekeza mahali pengine — bandika tokeni tena ili kurekebisha.
sw.ui_tg_last_error: Hitilafu ya mwisho ya utumaji ya Telegram: {error}
